headline: Alvarado Street's Spooky Juice is a fitting seasonal ale from the new Castroville brewery.
summary: There is a moment when Alvarado Street Brewery’s Spooky Juice is almost friendly. A mild, plush notion of stone fruit, citrus and gentle malt leaves the palate suspecting little more than a pleasant hazy evening.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
